::: {#rem-racket-quantifiers}
#### Quantifiers in Racket

On a finite list, Racket computes the two quantifiers with `andmap` and `ormap`.
Here they give the answers to parts 2 and 3 of @exr-finite-quantifiers:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(andmap odd? (list 2 3 5 7))
(ormap even? (list 2 3 5 7))
```

:::
